description: This file defines the high-level API for Ethernet Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) functionality for the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch. It includes function declarations for initializing EEE, enabling/disabling EEE per port, and retrieving port enable status.

methods.name: rtk_eee_init
methods.description: Initializes the EEE (Energy Efficient Ethernet) feature.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_set
methods.description: Sets the enable status of EEE on a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_eee_portEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of EEE on a specific port.
